questions.question: There are 55 employees in a line. Tina is 18th from the front and Mike is 20th from the back. How many employees are there between them?
questions.solution:
Total employees = 55

 
• Tina is 18th from the front.
 
• Mike is 20th from the back → from the front he is:
 
• 55 – 20 + 1 = 36.

So Tina is 18th, Mike is 36th.

Number of employees between them:

36 – 18 – 1 = 17.

There are 17 employees between Tina and Mike.

questions.question: X said to Y, "Your grandmother's only son is my father." How is X related to Y?
questions.solution:
Your grandmother’s only son is my father.”

 
• Y’s grandmother’s only son
 
 
• If a grandmother has only one son, that son is typically understood to be Y’s father (standard assumption in such reasoning questions).
 
 
 
• X says that this person “is my father.”
 
 
• So X and Y share the same father.
 
 

X is Y’s sibling (brother or sister).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**

questions.question: P said to Q: "The relative I met today was the wife of the grandfather of your mother's only son." How is the relative related to Q?
questions.solution:
• Your mother’s only son
 
 
• If Q’s mother has only one son, that son must be Q (since Q is addressed directly).
 
 
 
• Grandfather of Q
 
 
• This is Q’s grandfather.
 
 
 
• Wife of Q’s grandfather
 
 
• The wife of one’s grandfather is one’s grandmother.
 
 

Therefore, the relative that P met is:

Q’s grandmother.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question: Introducing a woman, Vivek said, "She is the daughter of my father's only son's wife." How is the woman related to Vivek?
questions.solution:
“She is the daughter of my father’s only son’s wife.”

 
• My father’s only son
 
 
• That is Vivek himself (assuming Vivek is male).
 
 
 
• My father’s only son’s wife
 
 
• That is Vivek’s wife.
 
 
 
• Daughter of my father’s only son’s wife
 
 
• That is Vivek’s daughter.
 
 

 The woman is Vivek’s daughter.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question: A woman says, "My brother's daughter is your only sister." How is the man related to the woman?
questions.solution:
My brother’s daughter is your only sister.”

 
• My brother’s daughter = the woman’s niece.
 
• This niece is the man’s only sister.

For the man’s only sister to be the woman’s brother’s daughter,**
the man must also be a child of the woman’s brother.

Therefore:

 The man is the woman’s nephew.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"**
